intro.title:
Welcome to

LFSB Planes Pictures
intro.text: LFSB Planes Pictures is a collection of aircraft photographs presented in an extensive gallery that can be filtered by aircraft type, registration, and operator.
intro.text2: Each photograph can be viewed individually with its aircraft details. LFSB Planes Pictures also extracts image metadata, showing not only the aircraft but how the photograph was taken.

about.title: Meet the photographer
about.text:
Hello! I am Laurent Greder, an aviation enthusiast and dedicated spotter.

My journey into aviation photography began several years ago, driven by a fascination with these engineering wonders and the stories they carry across the sky.
about.text2:
Although my main playground is the bustling EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg, I occasionally capture unique aviation scenes at Geneva Airport (LSGG) and Zurich Airport (LSZH).

Each location offers a distinct view of aviation, from busy international hubs to peaceful departures.
